BEFORE YOU PACK

Every item has
its own details.

A little information at the start helps make the service conversation more useful.

Check your item↗
  • Describe the exact item and quantity
  • Share the country and delivery postcode
  • Include the packed weight and dimensions
  • Mention any liquid, fragile or special contents
  • Ask the team about acceptance and paperwork before booking

A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Does appearing in this list guarantee acceptance?+

Please check with us before packing. Whether an item can be sent depends on its contents, destination and the selected courier service.

Can a business enquire about these categories?+

Yes. The existing company offering supports enquiries for both personal and commercial items. Describe whether the shipment is personal or commercial when contacting the team.

What if my item is not listed?+

Send a clear description, destination, quantity, weight and dimensions to the team. They can advise whether an available service may be suitable.
